claim: The Stroganoff Cookhouse has two cooking spots in the live game.

evidence.reference: Maintainer report in the wiki session, 19 November 2026.

notes: The decoded version 30 files give the Cookhouse five work spots, with one cooking spot (KitchenFire + StrogMix -> Stroganoff, 17.4 s) plus a fire spot, a Meat-slicing spot, a Mushroom-slicing spot and a mixing spot. The second cooking spot was probably added for the release; the version 32 files are not decoded yet. With two cooking spots a full crew of 2 is limited by worker time, not the stove: about 18 Stroganoff (36 food units) a day instead of about 10 (21).
